name: v29 quadratic fast score with original-score numerical recheck

v18_protocol.name: v18 Formal M2 Full-Model Quantization and Model-Level Evaluation

quantization.scope: all 168 decoder Linear modules; embeddings, tied lm_head, norms, and biases remain FP16
quantization.math: FP32 GPTQ statistics and compensation; dense quantized weights stored FP16

m2.selection_unit: independent alpha per output row, shared across all G128 groups of that row
m2.objective: direct local calibration output reconstruction MSE, X @ (Q_FP16.float() - W_FP16.float()).T
m2.tie_break: exact loss ties prefer the larger alpha
m2.prefix: the method's own previously committed dense quantized weights; q/k/v and up/gate use shared group input/H; refresh only at dependency boundaries
m2.candidate_isolation: all ten candidates use the same pristine current target W and shared H/Hinv state; candidate-local compensation state is fresh

calibration.source: v16 CALIBRATION_MANIFEST.json, copied byte-for-byte to this run directory

evaluation.primary_representation: dense-dequant FP16 weights for M1 and M2; original FP16 for M0
evaluation.c4_label: C4 validation fixed token budget PPL; not standard/full C4 PPL

gate.source: v16 frozen protocol and v17.3 corrected cost audit

inherit_from.v28_pure_quadratic_verdict: FAIL: 1 output row differs; retained as-is
inherit_from.model_checkpoint: v18 M2; same immutable revision and all non-search settings

scope.quantization: W4A16 symmetric dynamic GPTQ G128, block=128, damp_percent=0.1, desc_act=false, original compensation
scope.calibration: v18 frozen WikiText-2 train 128 documents x 2048 tokens; exact M2 own-prefix activations
scope.selection: per-row exact argmin; exact ties choose larger alpha

frozen_hybrid_rule.default_scorer: v27/v28 complete quadratic scorer C=X.T@X/N and e@C then FP64 row reduction
frozen_hybrid_rule.sensitivity_criterion: 2 * max_alpha(abs(quadratic_score-direct_score)) >= direct_best_second_gap, using v28 full-score empirical errors and exact frozen direct tie rule
frozen_hybrid_rule.trigger_unit: one full output-row Linear because v18 score_rows forms delta for all rows and one GEMM with the full output dimension; no output-row chunking
frozen_hybrid_rule.recheck: for any Linear with >=1 sensitive row, run all 10 candidates through unchanged v18 score_rows over the full row matrix; mixed scorer uses rechecked direct scores for every row in that Linear, quadratic scores elsewhere
frozen_hybrid_rule.selection: same frozen exact argmin and larger-alpha exact-tie rule; no fixed alpha and no threshold relaxation
frozen_hybrid_rule.claim_limit: experience-based numerical guard only; no general error guarantee

validation.phase1: full v29 score-mode dual run: one candidate per alpha; direct and quadratic share Q; recheck all 10 full-matrix direct scores for every trigger Linear; commit direct selection; save quadratic and hybrid results and compare tensors/selections
validation.phase2_gate: standalone hybrid-only M2 is optional and may run only if phase1 passes and remaining cumulative 90-minute budget covers measured/projected full run; never derive a claimed wall by subtracting score stages
validation.candidate_cache: retain each current Linear's ten Q/scale/zero candidate tensors on GPU until sensitivity decision and any recheck finish; record logical bytes and observed CUDA peak; no disk candidate cache
validation.recoverability: atomic checkpoints after dependency groups and layers; resume only verified contiguous groups; budget includes load, capture, warmup, candidate scoring, rechecks, checkpoint and final save
